doc: Screen part of s-hero: one perk group as a vertical tree of perk icons (laid out by the script native UiTreeLayout) on the parchment, scrolling vertically only: a row per tier, the root at the top, curved links down to each dependent (one <ui-links> drawing: each link its own arrival point and arrowhead, a lane of its own past a row of icons; the selected perk's links in gold, links from learned perks darker sepia, the others faint sepia). No names and no cards: an icon in an invisible 62 x 56 dp touch box, the state as a ring, a glow and a mark on the icon (check learned, lock locked), the other group's glyph on its corner. A tap reports `row <perk id>`; a long press shows the name (tooltip); the selected node jumps into view with a margin (snapping reveal of .pt-reveal).
